purpose: Move one guard outside the blast radius of the script it guards. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs a single validation step, npm run check, and every guard in this repository is invoked by that one command from a string inside package.json. A one-character edit to that string turns CI green while executing no test at all, and no control inside the scripts can notice, because the code that would reject it does not run.

amends_without_owning.rationale: THIS INCREMENT (2026-10-06) touches nothing outside this package's writable_paths, so it declares no amendment: scripts/verify-branch-scope.mjs exits 74 on an amendment that explains nothing the branch changed. The previous increment (a5c33fd, 2026-09-04, merged) declared five paths -- evidence/VERIFICATION.md, scripts/test-suite-contract.mjs, scripts/validate-work-package-ownership.mjs, scripts/verify-disposition-branch.mjs, test-kits/integrity-manifest.json -- to close two High guard defects found by independent review. That amendment is recorded in git history only: a5c33fd changed WP-0A-A0-004.json alone, and no owner manifest records it. WP-0A-A0-001.json carries one WP-0A-A0-004 entry, ownership.amended_by[2], which is the ci.yml transfer under RFC-2026-007, not this amendment; WP-0A-CON-008.json and WP-0A-A0-002.json contain no WP-0A-A0-004 entry. The WP-0A-A0-004 amended_by entries git log -S shows on those manifests were added in 086921a and removed in ae5864d (both 2026-09-02, before a5c33fd) and never recorded it. Until 2026-10-06 this field claimed the record stayed on those three manifests and listed them in recorded_on; that claim was false (A1 F2, evidence/WP-0A-A0-004/a1-security-reverify-2026-10-05.md) and recorded_on is now empty. Two of the five paths are guards owned by other packages (validate-work-package-ownership.mjs, WP-0A-A0-001; verify-disposition-branch.mjs, WP-0A-CON-008); a record in their own manifests would be theirs to write on their own branches.

acceptance_criteria: The workflow invokes node scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs as its own step, before npm run check, so a package.json edit cannot skip it.
The guard step precedes the composite step, so a failure is attributed to the guard rather than buried in a chain.
WP-0A-A0-001 retains every other declared output; only ci.yml moves, and the amendment is recorded in its ownership.amended_by.
npm run check still passes on pinned Node 24.20.0 / npm 11.19.0 with skipped and todo zero.
The ownership validator accepts the transfer with no cross-package overlap.

The workflow runs the branch-scope guard on every pull request, deriving the work-package id from the branch name and skipping cleanly when a branch names none. (2026-10-06: STALE in mechanism, not in effect. Since 8df0f4c (2026-09-02) the workflow no longer derives the package from the branch name: node scripts/verify-branch-identity.mjs resolves the branch to the one manifest whose ownership.branch names it, an unclaimed branch exits 75 and is then accepted only as a decision-record disposition branch (scripts/verify-disposition-branch.mjs), and every other unclaimed branch fails. That is stricter than "skipping cleanly". The criterion is judged against that behaviour.)
required_tests: Ownership validator across all manifests after the transfer
Repository protocol, role-separation, capability and secret-scan checks
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One workflow step and one path moved between two manifests; no persisted data, provider state, credential, migration or customer-data effect.
open_blockers: This does NOT make the guard unbypassable. Someone who can edit ci.yml can delete the step. It moves the bypass from a place no control can see into a place a reviewer reads, and no further.
It does not close the digest class: a commit editing a guarded file AND its digest still passes. Independent review established that as a fixed-point property.

The branch-scope guard runs only on pull_request events. A push to main carries no base to diff against, so the check is a pull-request control and not a branch-protection one; that distinction matters because protected CI is still an open Gate G0 item. (2026-10-06: native protection on main is now live and requires the check "bootstrap", which this workflow reports only for pull_request events and pushes to main. A commit therefore in practice reaches main through a pull request, where this step runs. The refusal of a direct push is measured, not inferred: evidence/g0-tracker-th.md:28 records a direct push to main, made as an admin, refused with "GH006: Protected branch update failed" / "Required status check "bootstrap" is expected" (cited 2026-10-06 for C0 F2 and Q0 Q4). That a run reports the check on the commit it tested is A1 F1's caveat, recorded below.)

CI tests the branch tip at checkout time, not necessarily the commit its result is reported on (A1 F1, LOW, evidence/WP-0A-A0-004/a1-security-reverify-2026-10-05.md §4): .github/workflows/ci.yml:54 checks out ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}, the branch name, and no step asserts that git rev-parse HEAD equals github.event.pull_request.head.sha. If the branch moves between the event and the checkout, the run tests the newer tip and reports on the older commit. Not reproduced. Pre-existing on main and not introduced by PR #189. ci.yml is in this package's writable_paths, but a change to it is a CI change, so the fix is a governance PR for the Product Owner (RFC-2026-025 §5 item 6), not an Author edit on this branch.
